name: Default
server: llama.cpp (llama-server), and any other OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible server
models: Any model that sees the page and can be made to call a tool
notes:
Built for Qwen 3 models running in llama.cpp. Works with most models.
Requires a model that can see images and can be forced to call a tool. Other models will misread pages or fail jobs.
Sends full instructions and every tool on each call, with one call per step. On a strong paid model, Lean Default uses far fewer tokens.
